currentRoundInspection.scope: Museum of Holocaust Art, Yad Vashem: distinct mapped long narrow concrete gallery, nearly blank courtyard elevation, deep rectangular entry and metal-lined vestibule with a recessed side door, pale roof slab/parapet and a plain blue wayfinding banner. The entry remains a real recess at all four LODs. Keep the independently mapped Exhibition Pavilion, Square of Hope courtyard, gardens, other campus buildings and underground museum rooms outside this asset.
